instruction: Change the slide's background to green and make the title text bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide background to green (#00FF00) and making the title bold. Original title is not bold by default.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: background color check + formatting/notes check
